title: Career Roadmap · Food Processing Technician
summary: A Food Processing Technician operates and monitors food-production equipment, follows hygiene and food-safety procedures, checks product quality, and supports packaging, preservation and processing operations.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Food Technology / Dairy Technology / related processing field

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science, especially Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics, is useful; entry requirements depend on the diploma.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Chemistry, biology, mathematics, food science and basic engineering.

blocks.label: Entrance/admission
blocks.text: State polytechnic entrance or merit-based admission, depending on the institution.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Dairy processing, fruit and vegetable preservation, grain milling, baking, packaging and cold-chain operations.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Hygiene, accurate measurement, equipment handling, teamwork and recordkeeping.

items.text: Diploma in Food Technology → Food Processing Technician, Production Assistant.
Diploma in Dairy Technology → Dairy Processing Technician, Milk Plant Operator.
Diploma in Chemical / Mechanical Engineering → Processing equipment and plant operations.
B.Tech / B.Sc. Food Technology → Food technologist, quality assurance or production roles, depending on employer requirements.
B.Tech Dairy Technology / Food Engineering → Dairy processing, product development and industrial operations.

blocks.text: FSSAI’s FoSTaC programme trains food-business personnel in food-safety and hygiene practices. It complements, rather than replaces, a technical qualification.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Recognised prior qualification, academic transcripts, English proficiency where applicable, prerequisite subjects and visa documentation. Diploma credit transfer depends on the institution; a diploma does not automatically qualify for postgraduate admission.
Verify current programme availability and admission requirements with each institution.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Food Production Technician, Processing Operator, Dairy Plant Technician, Packaging Technician, Quality Control Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Food manufacturing, dairy, beverages, cold-chain logistics and packaged foods.
Local food-safety rules and employer requirements vary. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.
